bases.compared: PoB base names (src/Data/Bases/*.lua) vs BaseItemTypes.Name, cleaned as PoB does (trimmed; `ö` written as `o`)

dnt-name.evidence: Export/Scripts/bases.lua skips bases whose display name contains `DNT`

energy-blade-rename.evidence: Export/Scripts/bases.lua writes `Energy Blade` as `Energy Blade One Handed` / `Two Handed`

not-in-base-spec.evidence: no row with this name is named by a #base or matched by a #baseMatch in the base specs Export/Scripts/bases.lua processes (its itemTypes list)

display-name-in-spec.evidence: a #base line in a processed base spec gives this display name to a game row

energy-blade-rename.evidence: Export/Scripts/bases.lua writes `Energy Blade` under this name

mods.compared: PoB mod IDs (src/Data/Mod*.lua, files keyed by mod Id) vs Mods.Id
disabled_rules: dnt-first-line: `not stats[1]:match("^DNT")` not found in src/Export/Scripts/mods.lua
unique-generation-without-family: `(mod.Family[1] and mod.Family[1].Id ~= "AuraBonus")` not found in src/Export/Scripts/mods.lua

src/Data/ModCache.lua.reason: parser cache keyed by mod text

src/Data/ModRunes.lua.reason: keyed by rune or soul-core base name (Export/Scripts/soulcores.lua)

aura-bonus-family.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua's item and item-exclusive writers skip mods whose first family is `AuraBonus`, and no mod PoB exports with the same domain and generation type has that family

domain-generation-not-exported.evidence: PoB's mod files hold no mod of this domain and generation type (counted per pair in `breakdown`). Derived from PoB's output, not from its writer conditions: a pair that a patch adds lands here, not in patch-delta

id-pattern-excluded.evidence: the Id matches a pattern that a writer in Export/Scripts/mods.lua excludes (`not mod.Id:match("<pattern>")`, read from the script), and no mod PoB exports with the same domain and generation type matches it (counted per pattern in `breakdown`)

no-description-line.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua writes a mod only if describeMod gives it a line (`#orders > 0`); reproducing describeStats over the files mods.lua loads (stat_descriptions.csd, with their includes) gives this mod none (stat slots 1 to 6, without the stats of its buff templates): no stat has a description there, or no English variant matches its values

zero-values.evidence: every stat describeMod reads (slots 1 to 6, without buff-template stats) is 0 to 0; Export/statdesc.lua's describeStats skips such stats (`v.min ~= 0 or v.max ~= 0`), so describeMod gives no line and Export/Scripts/mods.lua does not write the mod (`#orders > 0`)

passives.compared: PoB tree node IDs (src/TreeData/<newest>/tree.lua) vs PassiveSkills.PassiveSkillGraphId, placed with the passive skill graphs (passive_skill_graphs/)

dnt-name.evidence: on the Default tree's graph with a non-empty Name starting `[DNT` (other than [DNT] Kite Fisher, [DNT] Troller, [DNT] Spearfisher, [DNT] Angler, [DNT] Whaler); passivetree.lua skips it

empty-name.evidence: on the Default tree's graph with an empty Name; passivetree.lua skips it (`if passiveRow.Name == "" then goto exitNode`)

not-on-default-graph.evidence: not a node of the Default tree's graph (metadata/passiveskillgraph.psg); passivetree.lua builds PoB's tree from that graph's nodes only (breakdown: the other graphs the node is on, or no graph)

skipped-ascendancy.evidence: on the Default tree's graph with a kept Name, in an ascendancy whose Name starts `[DNT` or that is Disabled; passivetree.lua skips it

not-in-skill-spec.evidence: no `#skill <Id>` line in the skill specs Export/Scripts/skills.lua processes

stats.compared: stat IDs in PoB's converted stat descriptions (src/Data/StatDescriptions/**/*.lua) vs Stats.Id

not-in-converted-descriptions.evidence: PoB lists only stats named by the stat-description files it converts (src/Data/StatDescriptions); none of the installed counterparts of those files names this stat

stale-pob-description-file.evidence: only PoB files whose game stat-description file is no longer installed name it (PoB keeps converted files of removed game files)
